name: off-hours
description: iOS app that blocks work apps with Screen Time outside work hours, with on-call shifts, days off and calendar import.

scripts.test: npm run project:generate && xcodebuild test -project OffHours.xcodeproj -scheme OffHours -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro' -derivedDataPath .build/DerivedData -enableCodeCoverage YES
scripts.test:unit: npm run project:generate && xcodebuild test -project OffHours.xcodeproj -scheme OffHours -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro' -derivedDataPath .build/DerivedData -only-testing:OffHoursTests
scripts.build: npm run project:generate && xcodebuild -project OffHours.xcodeproj -scheme OffHours -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -derivedDataPath .build/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.ios:release: npm run project:generate && xcodebuild -project OffHours.xcodeproj -scheme OffHours -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -derivedDataPath .build/DerivedData -allowProvisioningUpdates build
scripts.lint: find OffHours OffHoursMonitor Shared OffHoursTests -name '*.swift' -print0 | xargs -0 swiftc -parse
scripts.format:check: xcrun swift-format lint --recursive --strict OffHours OffHoursMonitor Shared OffHoursTests
scripts.format: xcrun swift-format format --recursive --in-place OffHours OffHoursMonitor Shared OffHoursTests
